# The tests of the Spark Catalyst suites that fail with the candidate in the compliance mode of JANINO (input
# "javac-compliance" of the workflow "Spark"), because the compliance mode rejects the code that Spark generates for
# them, like "javac" does; see ".github/calcite/compare_junit.py", option "--known-failures".
#
# L-33 (JAVAC_DIFFERENCES.md): ScalaUDF generates "try { ... } catch (Throwable e) { throw
# QueryExecutionErrors.failedExecuteUserDefinedFunctionError(..., e); }", where the method returns "Throwable"; javac
# rejects the undeclared "Throwable" ("unreported exception"), and so does the compliance mode since #182.
